questions.q: What problem do global value sets solve?
options: They make picklists load faster in Lightning
They let a picklist have more than 300 values
They let the same list of values be defined once and shared across multiple fields/objects, instead of maintained as separate copies that can drift out of sync
They automatically translate picklist values into other languages
questions.explain: The lesson's example is a Region picklist needed on both Lead and Contact — built as two separate ordinary picklists, they can silently disagree once one is updated and the other isn't. A global value set defines the list exactly once.

questions.q: Where in Setup do you create and manage a global value set?
options: Picklist Value Sets, found via the Quick Find box
Object Manager → Field Dependencies
Permission Sets → System Permissions
Flow Builder → Variables
questions.explain: Entering Picklist Value Sets in the Quick Find box opens the list of every global value set defined in the org, with a New button to start one.

questions.q: When creating a new picklist field, what choice does the field wizard offer regarding global value sets?
options: There is no such choice — all picklists are global value sets automatically
The choice only appears on multi-select picklists
Only System Administrators can choose to use a global value set
Enter values specific to this field, or use a global picklist value set that's shared across objects
questions.explain: The field wizard offers 'Enter values, with each value separated by a new line' (an ordinary picklist) or 'Use a global picklist value set,' which points the field at a value set defined once and shared.

questions.q: A field was originally built as an ordinary, object-specific picklist. How does an admin convert it to use a global value set later, without starting over?
options: Delete the field and recreate it from scratch
Open the picklist field, click Edit, then Promote to Global Value Set, and give it a label
Contact Salesforce Support to migrate the field
It isn't possible — the field must be rebuilt as a new field
questions.explain: Promote to Global Value Set converts the field's current values into a new global value set that other fields can then point at too — no rebuild required.

questions.q: A Region value is added to a global value set used by both Lead and Contact. Does the admin need to separately add that value to each object's picklist field?
options: Yes, each object's field must be updated individually
Only if 'Restrict picklist to the values defined in the value set' is unchecked
No — since both fields point at the same shared global value set, the new value becomes available on both the moment it's added once
Only on whichever object was created first
questions.explain: That's the entire point of a global value set — it's defined once, and every field pointing at it shares exactly that one source of truth, so a single addition propagates to every field using the set.
